{{Top|leg}}
'''Kiskar Repulsorlifts''' was a company that had its corporate headquarters on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The building was equipped with the company's own [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlifts]] as a demonstration of the quality of their product. Because of this, the building hovered 5 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] off the ground, which enabled people to walk under it.<ref name="sos">''[[Coruscant Nights II: Street of Shadows]]''</ref>
